analysis.title: Vertiv Holdings (VRT): 3Q26 First Take
key_insights: GS calls Vertiv's 3Q26 a strong report and expects the stock to trade higher. 3Q26 results and 4Q26/2026 guidance are above both GS and the Street on revenue, adjusted EBIT and adjusted EPS.
3Q26 revenue was $4,313 mn, up 32% qoq as reported and up 55% yoy organically, versus GS $3,765 mn, Street $3,749 mn and a guidance range of $3,650-3,850 mn.
Organic growth by region in 3Q: Americas up about 66%, APAC up about 48%, EMEA up 19%. In 2Q these were +21%, +26% and -2%. Total organic growth was 55% vs 18% in 2Q.

Adjusted operating profit was $1,087 mn (25.2% margin) vs Street $922 mn (24.6%), GS $924 mn (24.6%) and guidance of $898-938 mn. Adjusted EPS including SBC was $2.21 vs Street $1.82, GS $1.81 and guidance of $1.77-1.83.
Vertiv cited strong demand, an expanding pipeline, organic orders up more than 100% yoy and momentum into 2027. It continues to take steps to improve supply.

4Q26 revenue guidance was raised to $4,313-4,513 mn (up 49-51% yoy organically) from $4,225-4,425 mn. GS is at $4,330 mn and the Street at $4,307 mn. 4Q adjusted operating profit guidance is $1,118-1,158 mn and adjusted EPS guidance is $2.22-2.28 (from $2.17-2.23).

2026 revenue guidance was raised to $14,450-14,850 mn (up 37-39% organically) from $13,800-14,200 mn. GS was at $14,019 mn and the Street at $14,008 mn. 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is $7.10-7.20 (from $6.65-6.75) vs Street $6.73 and GS $6.75.
2026 EBIT guidance was raised to $3,475-3,555 mn (midpoint 24.0% of revenue) from $3,285-3,365 mn. 2026 FCF guidance was raised to $2,600-2,800 mn from $2,400-2,600 mn.

On the 2Q supply chain and timing problems, Vertiv said earlier it was adding capacity and allowing more time for procurement and production. The 3Q presentation says it continues to invest in footprint and capacity and is extending supply chain agreements.

Vertiv closed the acquisitions of King Environmental Services and Utility Innovation Group (UIG). UIG cost about $1.45 bn in cash, about 13x expected 2027 EBITDA per Vertiv, plus up to $1.15 bn in additional cash tied to financial targets over 12 and 24 months. Vertiv expects UIG to be accretive to adjusted EPS in the first year.

GS expects the call to focus on demand, competitive position, the supply chain fixes since 2Q, and margins including cost pressures. GS rates VRT Buy with a 12-month price target of $301 (22x EV to Q5-Q8 EBITDA), against a $208.56 price on 27 Oct.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 and 4Q/2026 guidance beat GS and the Street on revenue, adjusted EBIT and EPS. Demand is strong with organic orders up more than 100% yoy, and GS expects the stock to trade higher.

earnings_insights: VRT 3Q26 reported revenue $4,313 mn vs GS est $3,765 mn and Street (FactSet) est $3,749 mn. Reported 10/28, above the $3,650-3,850 mn guidance range.
VRT 3Q26 adjusted operating profit (non-GAAP) reported $1,087 mn, 25.2% margin, vs Street est $922 mn (24.6%) and GS est $924 mn.
VRT 3Q26 adjusted EPS (non-GAAP, including SBC) reported $2.21 vs Street est $1.82, GS est $1.81 and guidance of $1.77-1.83. 3Q adjusted FCF reported $652 mn.

VRT 4Q26 guidance: revenue $4,313-4,513 mn vs GS est $4,330 mn and Street est $4,307 mn. Adjusted EPS $2.22-2.28 vs GS est $2.25 and Street est $2.21. Adjusted operating margin guidance of 25.3-26.3% is unchanged.

VRT 2026 guidance: revenue $14,450-14,850 mn, adjusted operating profit $3,475-3,555 mn, adjusted EPS $7.10-7.20 and FCF $2,600-2,800 mn. These compare with GS est revenue $14,019 mn, EBIT $3,346 mn and EPS $6.75, and Street est revenue $14,008 mn, EBIT $3,330 mn and EPS $6.73.
VRT 4Q26 organic sales growth is guided to the mid-50% range in the Americas and APAC and the low-20% range in EMEA.
risk_factors: Revenue growth: part of Vertiv's datacenter revenue is still tied to traditional on-premise datacenters, which could be hurt by weak enterprise spending or the shift to the cloud. Growth in cloud/hyperscale and the channel, and market share, will affect revenue.
Margins: risk to expected margin expansion from competitive pressure, mix, execution or tariffs.
Supply chain and timing problems that hit 2Q revenue are expected to be resolved in 2H26, and capacity and procurement have to keep up with demand.
